Hello and welcome. I am used to be an [[:Category:Administrators|admin]] of this here wiki. If you have any questions or need any help please leave a message for me on my [[User talk:Optimous|talk page]]. 
==About me==
My real name is Adam Shick. I live in Beaverton, OR. I have been a Wheel of time fan for over 15 years now. I used to just visit this website. Now I edit everything I know and use my skills in the wikipedia language to make new templates and make things look nice.
